About MG Avenues

We Build High-Value Real Estate Communities

At MG Avenues, we specialize in offering government-approved premium residential plots with modern infrastructure. Our mission is to help families build their dream homes and investors maximize their returns.

With over a decade of domain expertise, transparency, customer trust, and strategic site location, we stand as one of the most reliable real estate developers in the region.

Privacy Policy

MG Avenues Builders & Developers

MG Avenues Builders & Developers respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how information submitted through this website may be collected, used and protected when you enquire about our projects, request a brochure, check plot status, schedule a site visit or submit a plot booking request.

1. Information We May Collect

Depending on the service you use, we may collect information such as:

  • Name and mobile/WhatsApp number.
  • Email address and city/village.
  • Project, plot number and plot-related enquiry details.
  • Site visit date/time preferences and other information you voluntarily provide in forms.
  • Booking-related information required to process your enquiry or application.

2. How We Use Information

  • To respond to your enquiries and requests.
  • To provide project, plot availability and booking information.
  • To arrange site visits and communicate appointment details.
  • To verify contact details where verification is required.
  • To process and maintain records relating to plot enquiries or bookings.
  • To improve our website, services and customer support.

3. WhatsApp and Communication

When you choose to contact us or submit a request through WhatsApp, the information you provide may be processed through WhatsApp and related service infrastructure. We use the information to communicate with you about your enquiry, booking, site visit, brochure request or other service you requested.

4. Sharing of Information

We do not sell your personal information. Information may be shared with service providers or technology partners only when reasonably necessary to operate the website, process your request, provide communication/verification services, maintain records or comply with applicable law.

5. Data Security

We take reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect information submitted through the website. However, no internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

6. Data Retention

We may retain enquiry, communication and transaction-related information for as long as reasonably necessary for customer service, business records, legal, regulatory or dispute-resolution purposes.

7. Your Choices

You may contact us to ask about the personal information associated with your enquiry or to request correction of inaccurate information, subject to applicable legal and operational requirements.

8. Third-Party Services

This website may use third-party services such as Google Maps, WhatsApp and other infrastructure or communication providers. Their own terms and privacy policies may also apply to information processed by those services.

9. Contact Us
